verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew consists of Commander Reid Wiseman (NASA), Pilot Victor Glover (NASA), Mission Specialist Christina Koch (NASA), and Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, and mission specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen'; R3: 'commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch, and mission specialist Jeremy Hansen'; R5: 'commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, and mission specialist Christina Koch... mission specialist Jeremy Hansen from the Canadian Astronaut Corps'; R7: 'Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, and mission specialist Christina Koch from NASA, and mission specialist Jeremy Hansen from the Canadian Space Agency'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly list the exact crew members with matching roles and agencies.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is scheduled for a 10-day mission around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day journey'; R2: 'nearly 10-day flight'; R5: 'approximately ten-day trip'; R6: '10-day journey that will take them swinging around the moon'; R7: 'approximately 10-day mission... around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe the mission as approximately 10 days around the Moon.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will be the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'first lunar voyage in more than a half-century'; R3: 'return humans to the vicinity of the Moon for the first time in over 50 years'; R5: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; R6: 'first time in more than 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm it as the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 (over 50 years prior to 2026).

verifications.claim: Artemis II is Reid Wiseman's second spaceflight.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Wiseman flew previously as a flight engineer... 2014, logging more than 165 days in space'; R5: implies prior ISS mission in 2014 as commander for Artemis II
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly notes prior 2014 flight, making this his second.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover will be the first person of color to go to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Victor Glover will be the first person of color to go to the Moon'; R5: 'Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color'; R6: 'first person of color... on a lunar mission'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in sources confirm Glover as the first person of color.

verifications.claim: Christina Koch will be the first woman to go to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Christina Koch will be the first woman to go to the Moon'; R5: 'Christina Koch the first woman'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Koch as the first woman.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen will be the first Canadian to go to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Jeremy Hansen will be the first Canadian to go to the Moon'; R5: 'Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew has dubbed the Orion spacecraft "Integrity".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA’s Orion spacecraft (which they dubbed Integrity)'; R2: 'Their Orion capsule, dubbed Integrity'; R5: 'Orion CM-003 Integrity... named Integrity by the four-person crew'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources state the crew named it Integrity.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is testing the Orion spacecraft for future deep-space exploration.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'first crewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and the Orion spacecraft... test out its systems'; R5: 'test flight supporting subsequent Artemis missions... validate the Orion spacecraft's systems'; R7: 'first crewed flight test... verify today’s capabilities for humans to explore deep space'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe the mission as a test of Orion for future deep space/lunar missions.
